    """Calculator for likelihood ratios and Bayesian probability updates"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.epsilon = 1e-10  # Avoid division by zero

        """
        Calculate likelihood ratio for hypothesis testing
        LR = P(data|H1) / P(data|H0)
        """
        return p_data_given_h1 / (p_data_given_h0 + self.epsilon)
    
    def bayesian_update(self, prior, likelihood, marginal):
        """
        Apply Bayes' theorem to update probability
        posterior = (likelihood * prior) / marginal
        """
        return (likelihood * prior) / (marginal + self.epsilon)
    
    def compute_posterior(self, prior, p_data_given_h, p_data):
        """
        Convenience method for computing posterior probability
        """
        return self.bayesian_update(prior, p_data_given_h, p_data)
    
    def log_likelihood_ratio(self, p_data_given_h1, p_data_given_h0):
        """
        Calculate log likelihood ratio for numerical stability
